accountingRules: memory.stat file already includes shmem. The stated late values605392896 and233881600 imply371511296B aggregate non-shmem filecache; file+shmem would double count.
shmem includes tmpfs, SystemV shared memory and shared anonymous mmap. /dev/shm size16MiB does not bound PostgreSQL shared anonymous mappings or all shmem.
file_mapped, file_dirty, file_writeback and shmem are overlapping views/subsets; kernel_stack/pagetables/slab are inside kernel. Do not sum these with their aggregates.
Logical file length, allocated filesystem blocks, resident mapped pages and memcg-charged memory are separate ledgers. st_blocks/statvfs alone do not prove resident pages or a per-inode memcg charge.

Deduplicate aliases by filesystem/superblock identity and by inode for inode allocation claims. Do not add a filesystem statvfs total to its per-file block totals or count /ram/jit-root as a second filesystem.

RSS repeats shared mappings; PSS apportions mapped resident pages according to sharing, not memcg charge ownership. Do not add process RSS/PSS to memory.stat or subtract postmaster RSS/PSS from shmem/file.
A process/file using a page need not own its charge. First instantiation, cgroup provenance and area lifetime matter; foreign pre-cached sourcepages may stay charged to an older group.
memory.current, memory.stat, filesystem and smaps observations are sequential. Record brackets/duration; do not turn endpoint categories into a same-instant decomposition of historical memory.peak.

minimumEvidenceContract.PFNBoundary: Official pagemap documentation describes CAP_SYS_ADMIN-restricted PFNs and optional CONFIG_MEMCG kpagecgroup lookup. Neither is required or requested. No actual host capability/kernel-version claim is made; no privilege grant, injected agent or privileged collector is recommended.
minimumEvidenceContract.alreadySufficientForDiagnosticSetup: Existing JIT source operation + fresh dedicated tmpfs + original-overlay verification + same-group pre-PG counters and exact allocated-byte delta. PFN/kpagecgroup is not required for this restricted causal claim.
forALaterPrivateFilesystemAllocationClai: Predeclare the exact fixed phase, source/case identity and question. Record current/peak/stat immediately before and after the bounded filesystem/mapping read, monotonic times/duration, group identity and required-key presence; never reset peak.

Bind mount ID, filesystem type, dev/inode and namespace identity for the three private tmpfs filesystems. Measure each superblock once. Reuse the verified original JIT allocated-byte plan and source-supported lifetime; distinguish observed filesystem totals from inferred file membership.

Fresh inode provenance, ordinary writes by the admitted owned group, an exclusive controlled private-filesystem lifecycle and corroborating charge changes may establish restricted setup causation without PFNs. A claim about specific late inodes additionally needs metadata covering those inodes/lifetime; a root-directory inode alone is insufficient.

Keep mapped-residency evidence separate. Any known-postmaster smaps result is about that process only; PID/starttime/cgroup/namespace and capped complete-read status must be bound. Missing backend or other process coverage remains explicit; no global host walk or privilege escalation.

Record observed swap/missing swap visibility, allocation changes, deleted/unknown mapping candidates and all unreadable/cap outcomes. Do not fill missing fields with0 or infer exact charge from an approximate matching byte count.

predeclaredInterpretation.AVOIDABLE_MOTOR_RAM: No census alone establishes this. Required work can use diagnostically placed pages; reclaimability and placement do not prove avoidability. A later concrete structural candidate would need its own fair unchanged-workload whole-group functional/time/resource evidence. None is selected or authorized by this review.
predeclaredInterpretation.CONSISTENT_ONLY: Aggregate correspondence without exclusive inode/page provenance, complete relevant mapping coverage or time alignment remains a qualified association. Preserve unexplained quantities; do not assign a residual owner.
predeclaredInterpretation.FALSIFIED: A predeclared narrow allocation hypothesis is contradicted by qualified measurements, e.g. private filesystem allocation is not retained or its change has the opposite predeclared direction. This does not prove a different owner or saving.
predeclaredInterpretation.OBSERVED_LATE_ALLOCATION: Identity-qualified filesystem/mapping metadata can establish allocation/residency at its own fixed bracket. It does not automatically identify charged pages or demand necessity.
predeclaredInterpretation.PROVEN_DIAGNOSTIC_SETUP: Fresh controlled operation, provenance and same-group counter corroboration establish the allocation in its actual setup interval. This threshold is already met for original JIT tmpfs restoration.
predeclaredInterpretation.UNKNOWN: Unreadable/capped data, identity or source drift, unobserved relevant backend/phase, unbounded non-atomic drift or missing required counter invalidates the affected ownership claim. Functional PASS may remain separate, but attribution must not be promoted to PASS.
